verdict.rationale: Capsule CRM is a SaaS product with public developer docs, so an llms.txt file or agent-oriented docs are a fair thing to ask for. The evidence pack shows none: probes returned 404 for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI spec paths, and the docs only describe a standard REST API with Bearer-token authentication.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
